key_terms.الْأَوَّلِينَ: The earlier generations, predecessors, or former peoples
key_terms.ثُلَّةٌ: A crowd, multitude, or select group

ai.seo_question: What does 'thullah' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the continuity of divine guidance across generations, emphasizing that the 'multitude' often refers to the faithful remnant who preserved the truth amidst prevailing falsehood. It underscores the historical pattern where true believers, though sometimes few in number, remain the custodians of monotheism and prophetic legacy. This concept reinforces the Shia emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt as the enduring spiritual successors carrying forward the message of the earlier prophets.
